name: ADMASTON BROMLEY
ai_summary: The Township of Admaston/Bromley Council voted to adopt a new bylaw (2023-61) to regulate backyard chickens. Concurrently, the Council approved an amendment to the Fees and Charges By-Law (2023-62) to establish a permit fee for backyard chickens.

name: KAWARTHA LAKES
ai_summary: The municipality is endorsing the proposed heritage designation of 6673 Highway 35 (the Pattie House) under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act. This action is a direct response to amendments introduced by Bill 23, the More Homes Built Faster Act, which mandates municipalities to designate listed properties or remove them from the Heritage Register.
